test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The 10th Schedule of the Constitution of India, popularly referred to as the 'Anti-Defection Law', was inserted by the ______ Amendment.
solution:
The correct answer is __**52nd**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Anti Defection Law was passed in 1985 in Parliament But came into force in **2002.**
 
• The provision of Anti Defection Law is given in **10**th ** schedule of the Indian constitution**, by the **52nd Amendment Act.**
 
• The Anti Defection Law prevents any** Members of parliament to switch party for any personal reasons.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
 

 __Amendment Act__
 __Changes made__
 
 

 41st amendment act
 Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commissions retiring age changed from 60 to 62 years(article 316).
 
 

 42nd amendment act
 "Socialist" and "Integrity" added to Preamble, new directive principles of state policy added(Article 39A,43A,48A).
 
 

 
 
44th amendment act

 
 Right to property, not a fundamental right. It has been shifted from Article 31 to 300A.
 
 

 61th amendment act
 Changed eligible voters age from 21 to 18 years.
 
 

 69 amendment act
 Delhi was made the National Capital territory. It was awarded partial statehood and provided for a legislative assembly.
 
 

 86th amendment act
 The right to education was made a fundamental right(Article 21A).
 
 

 101 amendment act
 Introduction of Goods and service tax.
 
 

 103 amendment act
 Economically weaker section 10% reservation.
